title: Drive South & Great Ziggurat of Ur
full_text:
We will head south to Nasiriyah.
After lunch, we will drive to the historical city of Ur to visit the Great Ziggurat of Ur, a UNESCO world heritage site and the former capital of Mesopotamia during the Sumerian time.
The site includes Sholgi palace, and the oldest arch of its kind in the world at the entrance of Dub-Lal-Makh temple. We also can witness one of the most beautiful sunsets.
Free time for dinner
